TapeTape is an encrypted messenger built with privacy and security as its first principles.

Every chat is end-to-end encrypted on your phone, and each message can only be read by the people in the conversation.

TapeTape runs on the decentralized TapeRelay network, with no central server. Anyone can run a relay node, and nodes only pass along encrypted text.

The built-in decentralized wallet supports receiving, withdrawing, transfers and group red packets on X Layer and BNB Smart Chain, and lets you open your own on-chain shop in one tap. Your private key stays only on your phone, so keep your recovery phrase safe.

The code is fully open source (MIT License), so anyone can audit and verify it.
Every byte of these sites lives on the blockchain. The built-in Tapekit kernel reads the chain directly and verifies every byte, with no server in between.
